features.name: oc_comment_count
features.definition: How many counter-argument comments are in the discussion?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads; value = len(list) counting each list entry as one comment. Return null if missing or malformed JSON; empty list gives 0. Entries are not deduplicated by text or commenter.

features.name: has_three_plus_oc_comments
features.definition: Does the discussion contain at least three counter-argument comments?
features.spec: df['oc_comment_count'] >= 3 as 1/0; null if df['oc_comment_count'] is null.

h0: There is no difference in the probability of OP changing their view (delta) between discussions with has_three_plus_oc_comments=1 and those with 0.
h1: Discussions with has_three_plus_oc_comments=1 have a higher probability of OP view change than those with fewer than three comments.
note: Distinct comments are operationalized as separate entries in the OC_comments list (not deduplicated; entries may share a commenter). The list is the available set of counter-comments and may be a subset of all comments, and may be affected by sampling or by comments after the view change. OLS on binary delta is a linear probability model; association only, not causal.
